syllabi_source_consistency.name: syllabi_source_consistency
syllabi_source_consistency.value:
CHECK (
CASE source_type
    WHEN 'UPLOAD'::text THEN ((file_name IS NOT NULL) AND (storage_key IS NOT NULL))
    WHEN 'TEXT'::text THEN (text_content IS NOT NULL)
    ELSE true
END)
